name: ascii_locale_unicode_error
description: Code that writes non-ASCII text works on a UTF-8 developer machine but raises UnicodeEncodeError in a minimal CI container whose default locale is POSIX/C (ASCII), so Python's preferred encoding is ANSI_X3.4-1968.
source: https://peps.python.org/pep-0540/ (UTF-8 mode; C locale encoding pitfalls)
traceback: UnicodeEncodeError: 'ascii' codec can't encode character '\u2713' in position 3: ordinal not in range(128)
